# Align learn/comparisons/* openings with the two-hemisphere Application Engine identity

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 11 (`comparisons-identity`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

Under `"Engine vs Frameworks"` (`learn/comparisons/`: `Overview.md`, `NeoVsReact.md`, `NeoVsAngular.md`, `NeoVsVue.md`, `NeoVsSolid.md`, `NeoVsNextJs.md`, `NeoVsExtJs.md`):
1. Five of the seven pages open with `"Neo.mjs is a comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem"` — a generic 2025 self-description that names neither the **Off-Main-Thread Application Engine** (`Body`) nor the **Self-Evolving Software Organism / Agent OS** (`Brain` + `Neural Link`).
2. `learn/comparisons/Overview.md` carries a 2025 note about being generated with Gemini 2.5 Pro and compares only the 2025 Body layer, while the 2026 two-hemisphere positioning (`Body` + `Brain`, `459` `Neo.setupClass` classes in `39` namespaces, live runtime possession via the `Neural Link`, and comparison against agent/UI stacks) is missing from `Overview.md`'s identity opening.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 11 `comparisons-identity`, amended Nov 7) + `#20518` + ADR `0018` + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §2.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/comparisons/Overview.md` and `learn/comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md` are now directly linked from the opening audience paragraph of `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md`, `learn/README.md`, and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (`#20519`).
- **Mandatory `#20518` Conviction Guard:** Refreshing `learn/comparisons/*.md` must **sharpen** the technical comparisons and **keep full architectural conviction** (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §2; `NeoVsExtJs.md` §5's feature parity + modern successor thesis; `40,000+` delta updates/sec in [`Speed.md`](../benefits/body/Speed.md); `100,000`-row buffered grids; live cross-window component mobility on a `SharedWorker` heap; zero-build ES modules; live runtime inspection/mutation over the `Neural Link`). Never flatten a comparison into neutral corporate prose, and never call Neo.mjs a `"framework"`.

## The Fix

1. Rewrite `learn/comparisons/Overview.md`'s identity opening so it leads with the two-hemisphere architecture (**The Body**: Off-Main-Thread multi-window application engine with `459` classes in `39` namespaces linking [`CodebaseOverview.md`](../guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md); **The Brain**: Agent OS + `Neural Link` runtime possession linking [`Introduction.md`](../benefits/Introduction.md)).
2. Replace the stale `"Neo.mjs is a comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem"` opening across the sibling comparison pages (`NeoVsReact.md`, `NeoVsAngular.md`, `NeoVsVue.md`, `NeoVsSolid.md`, `NeoVsNextJs.md`) with the two-hemisphere Application Engine identity while preserving and sharpening every architectural comparison and benchmark receipt (`#20518` guard: stronger telling wins per paragraph).

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/comparisons/{Overview,NeoVsReact,NeoVsAngular,NeoVsVue,NeoVsSolid,NeoVsNextJs,NeoVsExtJs}.md` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 11 + `#20518` + ADR `0018` | Replace `"comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem"` with the two-hemisphere Application Engine + Agent OS identity; sharpen comparisons while keeping full conviction (including `NeoVsExtJs.md` §5 feature parity claim) | Link `CodebaseOverview.md` for class/component inventory per Row 14 | `learn/comparisons/*.md` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` ADR `0018`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Two-Hemisphere Identity):** Zero occurrences of `"Neo.mjs is a comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem"` or `"framework"`-for-Neo remain in `learn/comparisons/*.md`; `Overview.md` and siblings lead with the two-hemisphere Application Engine + Agent OS (`Neural Link`) identity.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Conviction & Ext JS Parity Preserved):** `NeoVsExtJs.md` §5's feature parity claim and all architectural advantages across `learn/comparisons/*.md` are kept at full strength (`#20518` guard).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Flattening is not sweeping (`#20518`):** Never tone down Neo.mjs's architectural advantages over single-threaded frameworks or soften `NeoVsExtJs.md`'s feature-parity thesis.
